verses.thai: จะกล่าวแต่เฉพาะที่แปลก ส่วนที่ไม่แปลกและคำอธิบายวิธีต่างๆ ซึ่งเหมือนกันกับ 2 วิธี ที่กล่าวมาแล้ว จะไม่กล่าวอีกขอให้พลิกกลับไปศึกษาใน 2 วิธีนั้น แม้คำขออุปสมบทพร้อมกัน (สังฆัมภันเต) ก็ได้อธิบายไว้แล้วท้ายคำขออุปสมบทแบบ เอสาหัง
verses.english: Only what differs will be given. What does not differ, and the explanations of the various procedures which are the same as the two methods already given, will not be repeated — please turn back and study them there. Even the request for ordination together (saṅghambhante) has already been explained at the end of the request for ordination in the Esāhaṃ form.

verses.pali: เอเต มะยัง ภันเต,
verses.english: We go for refuge to that Blessed One, though he attained final Nibbāna long ago, and to the Dhamma and to the community of monks. May we obtain the going forth in that Blessed One's Dhamma and Discipline; may we obtain ordination.

checks.issue: ⚠ THE BOOK TELLS THE READER TO LOOK ELSEWHERE. This chant opens with a Thai note saying that only what DIFFERS from the two forms already given will be printed, and that the reader should turn back to study the rest there. So the pair form is deliberately incomplete on the page — the book is cross-referencing itself, not omitting by accident. Recorded as a verse because it is printed inside the chant, below its heading.

THE LINES ABOVE THIS CHANT BELONG TO PAGE 288. The tail of the single-candidate request, a substitution rubric telling the reader to change ยาจามิ to ยาจามะ and มัง to โน, a long Thai instruction covering the whole ceremony, and a centred SERVICE CLOSING — จบพิธีอุปสมบทแบบเอสาหัง — all belong to the chant that begins on 288 and are left for that page's batch.

THE CHANT IS CUT BY THE PAGE BREAK BETWEEN ITS TWO HALVES. The refuge-and-request rounds end at the foot of 289 and the going-forth rounds open at the top of 290, above คำขอนิสสัยนาคคู่. Each half opens its own paragraph, so verse 5 carries para_start in its own right rather than continuing one.

batch_status.notes: THE PAIR FORM OF THE GOING-FORTH REQUEST. One finding, and it is about the book's method rather than its text: ⚠ THE BOOK CROSS-REFERENCES ITSELF. This chant opens by saying only what DIFFERS from the two forms already given will be printed and that the reader should turn back for the rest. So the pair form is incomplete on the page BY DESIGN — the same habit as the ฯลฯ abbreviation on 295, which pages 293-294 turned out to fill in. Nothing has been supplied from outside.
